As mentioned in our comment/reply, we don’t mind the wait. We use FSD V12.6.4 daily, and have many completely end-to-end drives without disengagements.

Our experience has been favorable; that is not the case for all. Voices matter, and we’ll be happy when this chapter closes.

A comment / our thoughts on the state of HW3 and a Full Self-Driving (Unsupervised) future, from a HW3 owner.

We are quoting this as @SawyerMerritt has highlighted that the #1 investor question right now pertains to HW3.

Would value everyone’s thoughts as usual!


Teslascope (@teslascope)

As a HW3 Model 3 owner (and one of the first to get a retrofit from HW2.5), I don’t think it’s per se an issue with the answer we’ve received from Tesla, and more so the timeline.

Everyone has their own tolerances for waiting; while I don’t mind waiting years, others feel differently. Many will lose their vehicle or sell it (whether to upgrade to another Tesla or not) before seeing Unsupervised come to fruition.

So I think that rephrasing the question to request a formal timeline and commitment, rather than guestimations, would appease the largest group of HW3 owners.

“You will receive Unsupervised after we solve it on AI4” has already been given (and is a solid answer). Still, without tangible commitments, it leaves owners (and retail investors) with more questions. If a software only solution is on the table, more confidence is necessary. If a form of retrofit is required, try to set a firm limit on anticipation.

I believe we all mutually feel this way. ❤️



— https://nitter.net/teslascope/status/2044495383662121082#m
